settings.heading: Thread over trend.
settings.intro: LINUX is a Cairo streetwear label. Every piece is embroidered — not printed — so the mark lives in the fabric, not on it. We cut heavyweight melton, stitch it in our Cairo studio and ship it across Egypt.

settings.heading: Print cracks. Thread doesn't.
settings.body: Our wordmark is sewn at 4,000 stitches per minute, and it will outlive the hoodie it sits on.
